title: Design an animated control room for your AI agents
summary: A developer used Claude Code and Three.js to build an animated visual prototype showing agent runs moving through stages, jobs and system health on one screen.
agent_role: Claude Code wrote the animated interface from the author's concept; the author designed the run stages and panel ideas.
outcome: Author reports a working visual prototype only, not yet connected to real agents.
what_they_did: The author wanted a clearer view of many agents running at once. They sketched run stages like start, busy and done. Then they had Claude Code build an animated 3D interface with Three.js, a web graphics library.
how_it_went: The author says they got a visual prototype with panels for jobs, activity and system health. It is only a concept so far.
worth_knowing: It is a look-and-feel mockup; it does not yet read real data from running agents.
prompt: Build a single-page web prototype using Three.js that visualizes a set of AI agent runs. Show each run moving through these stages: [list your stages, e.g. started, working, busy, done]. Add side panels for active jobs, recent activity and overall system health, using sample data for now. Keep the code in [project folder]. Show me your plan and file layout first, then build it and tell me how to open it in my browser.

curation.rationale: A genuine but thin example of using Claude Code to build an animated 3D dashboard prototype; little detail on steps or the agent's role.
